observations: Photo 0: Side view of a blue truck cab with visible front and rear wheels, showing a 6x4 configuration (three axles, two driven). The cab has a '3140' badge on the side. The front wheel is a single tire, rear axle is dual. The truck has a tipper body attached, partially raised. The paint is chipped and faded, with rust visible on the wheel hubs and undercarriage. The front fender is damaged, with a missing section exposing the frame.

Photo 1: Front view of the same blue truck. The grille has 'MAN' written on it, with a '3140' badge below. The truck has a tipper body. The front bumper is damaged, and the headlights appear intact. The truck is parked on a dirt lot with other trucks in the background. The front wheels are single, rear axles are dual.

Photo 2: Rear view of the tipper body. The body is blue with visible rust, dents, and peeling paint. The rear wheels are dual. A Nigerian license plate is visible: 'LDS 178'. The tipper body has a hydraulic system visible at the rear. The undercarriage shows signs of wear and rust.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the MAN brand on the grille, and photos 0 and 2 show a 6x4 configuration (three axles, two driven) with dual rear wheels, totaling 10 tyres (2 front single + 8 rear dual).

Photos show significant wear: chipped and faded paint, rust on wheel hubs and undercarriage, damaged front fender and bumper, dents and peeling paint on the tipper body. These are not consistent with 'good condition'.

risks.proof: Video of the engine starting and running, or a mechanic's inspection report.

risks.risk: Tipper mechanism failure or hydraulic leak
risks.proof: Video of the tipper body raising and lowering smoothly without leaks.

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage or frame rust
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chassis and frame, especially under the cab and near the axles.

risks.risk: Unregistered or expired Nigerian license plate
risks.proof: Clear photo of the license plate with registration details, or a copy of the vehicle's registration document.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered or with legal risk

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the tipper body raising and lowering.
Close-up photos of the chassis and frame for rust or damage.
Clear photo of the license plate and vehicle registration document.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a MAN 3140 10-tyre tipper truck. The seller's claim of 'good condition' is contradicted by visible wear and damage. The item can be priced at its worst case (with all risks factored in), and the required proof requests are listed to improve the valuation.
